name: juggle-mcp
description: Juggle (whyjuggle.com) babysitting and petsitting for Claude — your family account's sits, sitters and messages via natural language

juggle_email.title: Juggle email
juggle_email.description: The email address you sign in to whyjuggle.com with (a family account).

juggle_password.title: Juggle password
juggle_password.description: Your whyjuggle.com password. Google/Facebook-only sign-ins are not supported — set a password on the site first.

mcp_confirm_mode.title: Write confirmation mode
mcp_confirm_mode.description: What a write (post a sit, accept/decline a sitter, cancel, message, favorite, review) does on a client that cannot show a prompt: ask-user (default) needs your approval in chat, auto lets the model confirm after reviewing the preview, refuse blocks writes.

tools.name: juggle_healthcheck
tools.description: Check the Juggle sign-in is configured and accepted, and that an authenticated page read works
